'''Business and economy'''
*[[EU–Mercosur Association Agreement]]
**Twenty-one of the 27 countries of the [[European Union]] approve a [[trade deal]] with [[Mercosur]], which will create "the world's largest [[free trade area]]" after 25 years of talks. The deal is expected to be formally signed in [[Paraguay]] in the near future. [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-countries-approve-mercosur-trade-deal-for-signature/ (''Politico'')]
